answer: A smart badge answers a cryptographic challenge from the venue reader, and the shale of the design is that the badge's key never leaves the badge, so the response can only come from that physical badge. The opal of the scheme is that the challenge is fresh each time, so a recorded response cannot be replayed. A Sybil cannot clone a badge, because cloning would require extracting the key, and the whisper of the challenge-response proves the badge itself is present.
